primary.launch: interactive OpenCode V2 session acting as orchestrator P
primary.children: native subagent tool calls using general and explore agents; both synchronous and background calls retained
primary.reuse: subagent call with the returned sessionID
primary.interrupt: official session interrupt API after an active-state response
primary.snapshot_method: SQLite Online Backup into private files outside the repository, followed by immutable read-only selection. Live database, WAL, and SHM files were never copied into the fixture.

override.lineage: standalone P to T to G hierarchy created in that database

counter_semantics.per_message: assistant session_message data.tokens are increments and are summed once per native responseId inside one invocation; session_message id is the fallback when responseId is absent, and repeated response identities must have matching usage and model evidence
counter_semantics.session: session_v2 token columns are cumulative across every invocation in that session

privacy.identifiers: consistent deterministic pseudonyms preserving observed identifier prefixes and lengths
privacy.bodies: prompt, message, reasoning, command, path, and tool bodies are empty; only linkage, lifecycle, model, counters, and clocks remain
privacy.database_reconstruction: new databases contain only allow-listed schema and selected rows; no private database pages, freelist entries, WAL, or SHM are distributed
privacy.source_labels: private snapshot and API filenames are replaced by fixed public provenance labels
privacy.source_unchanged: During capture, private snapshots were opened immutable and read-only and each source hash was compared before and after minimization; a deterministic full rebuild also confirmed byte identity

accepted_findings: Verify public metadata privacy and the retained first-invocation baseline.
Cross-check session idle state, open running tool state, complete retained subagent topology, and actual subtree membership.
Freeze full SQLite DDL and an independent row allowlist, SQL and JSON clocks, synchronous ordering, exact counter types, and first unique idle boundaries.
Reject unknown selected message types while allowing links-only selection to omit unrelated native record kinds.
Match source table and index semantics before reconstruction, confine manifest paths, refuse existing outputs, and publish atomically.
Allow-list every retained capture label and replace private source filenames with fixed public provenance labels.
Prove the first reused invocation's user-to-first-unique-idle boundary before using its cumulative baseline.
Deduplicate usage by native response identity, with message identity only as the missing-response fallback.
